entities.summary: Rasmus Bengtsson is a Swedish professional ice hockey player. He is currently playing for IK Oskarshamn of the HockeyAllsvenskan (Allsv). He was drafted in the second round of the 2011 NHL Entry Draft by the Florida Panthers with the 59th overall selection.
